claim: A discount percent of 0 is outside the valid range 1-50 and must return 400.
A discount percent of 51 is outside the valid range 1-50 and must return 400.
A negative discount percent is outside the valid range 1-50 and must return 400.
A discount can only be applied by the owner of the order; any other caller must receive 403.
A discount percent far above 50 is outside the valid range and must return 400.
